name: customer-support-portal
description: Multi-Tenant Client Feedback & Support Portal (Phase 1: Foundation & Auth)

scripts.dev:auth-service: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter auth-service start:dev
scripts.dev:gateway: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter gateway start:dev
scripts.dev:backend: pnpm run build:shared && concurrently -n auth-service,gateway -c yellow,cyan "pnpm:dev:auth-service" "pnpm:dev:gateway"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:auth-service && pnpm run build:gateway && pnpm run build:tenant && pnpm run build:customer && pnpm run build:support && pnpm run build:admin
